post.summary: Negotiate a Hugging Face LFS upload
post.description: Accept a SHA-256 LFS upload batch request and return basic-transfer upload and verification actions. Each object is bounded by the service size and quota limits, backed by a durable upload intent, and must pass checksum and size validation before it can be committed. Only model repositories and the legacy basic LFS transfer are supported; Xet and other LFS transfers are not provided.

200.description: LFS transfer selection and per-object upload/verify actions.

schema.title: Response Lfs Batch  Namespace   Repo  Git Info Lfs Objects Batch Post

post.description: Upload one or more files to create or update a model repository revision. Files are stored and tracked with their content hashes.
Generate a presigned URL for uploading a file directly to object storage for a specific repository revision.
Finalize an upload by creating or updating a revision and tracking records for all uploaded files in object storage.

post.summary: Prepare a Hugging Face commit upload
post.description: Inspect a bounded list of files from a Hugging Face commit request and select regular or legacy LFS upload mode by file size. The response contains one upload decision per path; storage limits and total request limits are enforced. This endpoint does not make files visible; use the corresponding upload and commit operations. Xet is not supported.

200.description: Per-file upload modes and ignore decisions.

schema.title: Response Preupload Huggingface Files Api Models  Namespace   Repo  Preupload  Revision  Post

post.description: Apply newline-delimited JSON file, LFS-file, and deletion operations atomically to a model revision. Regular uploads use bounded service storage and LFS files must reference validated durable upload intents; existing repository contents remain unchanged if validation or commit fails. Repository authorization, quotas, checksums, and size limits apply. Xet commit operations are not supported.

200.description: The committed revision identifier and commit URL.

schema.title: Response Commit Huggingface Files Api Models  Namespace   Repo  Commit  Revision  Post
